title: IndiaAI Face Authentication Challenge
system_name: AI face authentication & de-duplication for public examinations (unnamed, in procurement)
technology_type: facial verification, one-to-many matching, automated duplicate detection
evidence_sentence: This challenge invites startups and companies to develop a highly accurate, secure, and scalable AI-enabled solution for image verification and application de-duplication... Up to two top teams may be awarded a two-year contract and up to INR 1 Crore for final solution deployment.
notes: BORDERLINE. Codebook tension: 'R&D prototypes out' vs 'announcements with no deployment evidence -> in, announced'. Coded IN: it is a procurement with a 2-year contract and a named deployment target (public examinations), not open research.

title: UIDAI fingerprint liveness detection
system_name: AI/ML fingerprint liveness detection for Aadhaar authentication (in-house, unnamed)
deploying_body: Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI), MeitY
technology_type: AI/ML combining finger minutia + finger image for liveness / spoof detection
evidence_sentence: The Unique Identification Authority of India (UIDAI) under the Ministry of Electronics & IT has successfully rolled out a new security mechanism for Aadhaar based fingerprint authentication... The artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) based security mechanism developed in-house is now using a combination of both finger minutia and finger image to check the liveness of the finger print captured.
notes: CLEAREST CASE IN SAMPLE. In-house, live, at scale (~70M authentications/day). Domain spans welfare/finance/telecom; coded welfare because the release cites welfare benefits and Aadhaar-enabled payments.
